label: final copy step of length-3 sequences (weak tail on final copy steps of longer sequences)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L). It never fires in the original phase or on the delimiter step. The reliable core is the last copy step of L=3 sequences (t=5, outputting orig(2), with input orig(1)). It fires on about 99% of those steps, and they hold about 50% of activation mass and nearly all of the top quartile. The strongest cases have input m (e.g. b m m <DEL> b [m]). Outside L=3 it fires weakly and sparsely (2-7% rate) on the final or second-to-last copy step of longer sequences: to_go==0 covers 81% of mass and to_go<=1 covers 93%, but at low precision. Which of those late steps fire depends on the tokens in a way I could not capture (in_tok m/3/0 and out_tok e/t/c/j are mildly enriched). It almost never fires for L=5 and never on early copy steps (to_go>=6).
